fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Penstock Transient (rigid water-column ODE)
source: Harvey et al. (1993) Micro-Hydro Design Manual, IT Publications; Penche (1998) Layman's Guidebook on How to Develop a Small Hydro Site, EC DGXVII; Chaudhry (2014) Applied Hydraulic Transients, 3rd ed., Springer; White (2011) Fluid Mechanics, 7th ed.

unit.name: Generic 450 kW Francis Micro-Hydro Plant — Physics-Lumped Penstock Transient

H_gross.note: Gross static head, forebay to tailrace (Francis range 20-300 m)

eta_turbine_peak.note: Peak hydraulic turbine efficiency (Francis); Harvey 1993 Table

k_eff.note: Parabolic part-load efficiency curvature for Francis

q_min.note: Minimum flow ratio for stable operation

f_darcy.note: Darcy-Weisbach friction factor (welded steel, fully rough turbulent)

K_minor.note: Sum of minor loss coefficients (entrance, bends, valve)

A_forebay.note: Forebay / surge-tank free surface area (mass-oscillation buffer)

tau_nozzle.note: Guide-vane / nozzle actuator time constant (first-order servo)

rho.note: Water density at 20 C, 1 atm; White (2011) Table A.1
